title: [v2.8.2.1-dev-d] Overview and Treatment tab not updated with TBR
symptom: In AAPS v2.8.2.1-dev-d, the Overview and Treatment tabs stop updating with TBR records. Basal shown on overview reverts to profile basal, no new TBR records appear in Treatment tab, and manual TBR from action tab is not visible. Loop continues to work and set TBRs, but the UI does not reflect them. Restarting AAPS, rebooting phone, and synchronizing pump do not resolve the issue.
cause: The issue is a regression introduced between dev-c (March 01) and dev-d (March 17), related to the Insight driver and database.
fix: Downgrade to a previous version (2.8.2.1-dev) to recover data, then update back to dev-d. The issue was eventually fixed by an update to the Insight driver and database.
evidence_quote: Fixed by Insight driver and database
